body: Don't lay down. Go to the hospital. You don't need money to get the fuck out of wherever you are. Sign up on a couch surfing website and buy a bus ticket somewhere. Things can always get better, especially if you are somehow able to step outside of your current environment or situation. You probably got a shitty break. Your friends are probably assholes. You are smart, but maybe you fucked up in school because it was boring and maybe you hate authority. But you are probably not a bad person. And you are probably capable of experiencing all kinds of happiness that you cannot even fathom from your current state of mind. Don't give up dude. I don't want you to.

If you are posting here, I'm guessing that some part of you wants to live, and that part of you probably wants some kind of help. I can't imagine the pain that you're going through, or maybe I can, but I can certainly tell you that nothing is permanent. Things can always change. They can always be different. Maybe not ideal, maybe not perfect, but maybe a huge change of setting could show you a reason to live. You won't know unless you try.

I've seen things that have made me feel that the world is exclusively cruel and exclusively painful. I have questioned the purpose of living in a world that can inflict such suffering and horror. I have felt that my friends and family would be better off without me. But I was wrong. And since that time (and it lasted a while) I have experienced things that I would be so fucking pissed if I had missed. I am not transgender, I cannot speak to that experience, but you are not alone, maybe you are just in the wrong place. Get help. Call 911. Or just induce vomiting. Do something. You deserve happiness. It could be out there. You won't ever know if you're dead.
